name: Petal Trace Charcoal Green Short Kurta
description:
Product Description: 
Petal Trace is a modern festive essential crafted in a breathable fabric with a soft, understated sheen. The relaxed-fit silhouette is accented with delicate floral line embroidery, tracing organic petal forms that add subtle texture and quiet elegance. Finished with a clean mandarin collar, it keeps the look refined yet effortless.
Styling:Style it with straight-fit jeans for a contemporary festive look or pair it with classic ethnic bottoms for a more traditional finish. Complete with minimal leather footwear or mojaris.Material: 100% Cotton
Color: Green
Model Size: M
